name: Canvas Status Bar
description: Status bar UI widget pinned to the bottom of the IDE window. Shows zoom level (with lock/unlock SVG icon), workspace name, and a 'view all' reset button. Clicking zoom toggles lock. Clicking the reset-zoom icon (visible when zoom != 1x && unlocked) resets zoom to 100%. Injects elements into #statusbar DOM element.

interface.constructor: constructor() — no arguments, initialization deferred to init()

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates and injects status bar DOM elements (zoom display, lock indicator, workspace name, view-all button) into #statusbar. Guards against duplicate initialization.

methods.name: update
methods.signature: (locked: boolean, scale: number, workspaceName: string, onLockToggle: (() => void) | null, fitAll: () => void, resetZoom?: (() => void) | null): void
methods.description: Updates all status bar display values: zoom percentage with lock/unlock icon, reset-zoom icon visibility, workspace name. Stores callbacks for interactive elements.
